method: Actual running Editor host + macOS development standalone client. Opt-in probe invokes real motor/RPC; server Rigidbody/FixedUpdate actual physics. Some initial deck cargo and water recovery states use explicit test fixtures. NOT native physical keyboard/window focus evidence.

host driving with client standing/walking/jumping and landing
client driving with host standing/walking/jumping and landing
strict host and client pickup/carry/drop for each 3/12/35kg with opposite active driver
three server dynamic deck cargo, no parenting/kinematic deck lock
carry restriction and heavy sprint state
busy helm request rejection; carrying helm rejection
normal and lag driver disconnect zeroes input/releases driver and coasts
normal late join/reconnect into current boat
normal physical player walking off deck and actual rescue
normal and lag R cleans carry and helm state
normal and lag server cargo submerged fixture recovery
lag both driver directions/jump/three mass carry/drop
notVerified: native macOS physical W focus loss (native bridge failed)
human physical keyboard/mouse full two-window tour and continuous visual jitter appraisal
true simultaneous helm acquisition race (sequential busy rejection is not race)
lag-specific reverse/physical water walk/late join repetitions
long stress/large cargo piles/high speeds/waves/load balancing
failedAttempts: Early dynamic docking moved boat from ramp collision: fixed docking clamp/inertia, retest stable.
Early moving-deck jump lost grounded state: fixed pre-platform grounded capture; real air/landing retested.
Early cargo named tests had expired throttle or wrong target: indices24..29 not passes, strict mass/holder/driver/speed later retested.
First final offline carry run interrupted by Editor domain reload; fresh Play 24-check run passed.
Domain reload transient CLI request/build queue failures; actual completed delivery build identified separately.

Editing Editor setup while network Play was active triggered domain reload, FOUR Input System map assertions and TWO NGO NetworkSceneManager.Dispose NullReferenceExceptions (seq95..100). These are actual errors, not just CLI errors. Clean restart offline regressions and final network session/three reconnects/shutdown returned zero new entries after seq105. Hot-reload during live NGO sessions is unsupported here; stop Play before script edits.
normalization: Probe ulong.MaxValue (no driver/holder) normalized to 'Nobody' to avoid JS numeric precision loss; all real low-valued object/client IDs remain numeric.
